_readme: Every knob the agent obeys. Full docs: README.md#settings.

run._max_note: 0 = no per-run cap (Dominick, 2026-10-04): apply to every lead that passes the gate. ./run.sh N still caps one run at N.
run._model_note: Model for headless runs (run.sh / scheduled). sonnet uses far less of your plan than opus and is plenty for form filling. Empty = your account default.
run._freeze_note: Off (2026-10-05, Dominick: 'don't wait til tomorrow'): a second role at a company the same day is allowed. The lifetime cap of 2 per company still applies, and the best-fit role is taken first.

schedule._frequency_options: manual | hourly | every-2-hours | every-3-hours | every-6-hours | daily | weekdays

roles: software engineer in test / test automation (SDET)
targets._seniority_note: Early-career/mid-level hire. Set to ["new-grad","internship"] for a student. New-grad/campus and intern postings are dropped when absent.
targets._locations_note: New York, NY (in person or hybrid), Chicago, IL (in person or hybrid; would relocate), or remote in the US.
targets._min_annual_comp_note: Floor is BASE salary and passes when the posted band's TOP reaches it (Dominick 2026-10-05: $120K). Jobs with no posted pay are applied to.
targets.prestige_note: One or two sentences on what makes a company worth your time. Used as a judgment gate when a posting lists no pay.
skip_notes: Skip any title containing Senior, Staff, Lead, Principal, or Manager.
targets._roles_note: Software engineer and adjacent roles (2026-10-05). Still skipped: iOS/Android/mobile, embedded/firmware/hardware, analytics engineer, data scientist, research scientist, IT/support, network engineer, sales/solutions engineer.

broker._broker_note: Optional. On Windows the app password goes in Windows Credential Manager: in your own PowerShell run `cmdkey /generic:jobapply-gmail-imap /user:<gmail> /pass` and type it at the hidden prompt. Check with `python3 scripts/code_broker.py check`.

collector._readme: scripts/collect.py: finds, vets and saves leads with no Claude usage. run.sh runs it before every session.

collector._self_id_note: false (2026-10-05): Dominick authorized the agent to fill self-ID dropdowns from config/profile.json. If a session's permission check still blocks it, the job goes to 'Apply yourself' at that point.
collector._blocking_note: Empty (2026-10-05): every known blocker now has an answer in config/answers.md. Add a pattern here when a new recurring question has no fact on file.
collector._interval_note: collect.py skips itself if it ran within this many minutes (--force overrides), so sessions can call it whenever the pool runs dry.
collector._min_fit_note: Leads scoring under this (0-100, scripts/fit.py) are skipped before the agent can claim them: off-target roles waste claims and tokens.
collector._stale_note: Older open postings stay in the queue but are worked LAST (fresh first, then best fit); only postings over this many days old are dropped.
